description: Voorkeursgebieden windenergie is a dataset listed in National Georegister of the Netherlands, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoportaaloverijssel.nl. This stock contains areas designated for wind energy generation by means of wind turbines. It is a rough limitation usable on a scale of less than 1:100 000. In the summer of 2023, the province of Overijssel adopted a tightening of its wind policy. Coverage: NL. The portal shows the English title as "Preferred areas for wind energy" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2024-09-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ngr-nl.
